description: Scrape Amazon influencer/creator storefronts (/shop/{handle}): profile info, Idea Lists, and creator videos.

crawlIdeaLists.description: When true, opens each Idea List (up to `maxLists`) and extracts individual products (up to `maxItemsPerList`). When false, only the list summary cards (title, declared item count, image) are emitted.
crawlIdeaLists.title: Crawl Idea List items

handles.description: Amazon influencer handles, e.g. `gearvlogz` (from amazon.com/shop/gearvlogz). Combined with `marketplaceDomain` to build the shop URL.
handles.title: Creator handles

marketplaceDomain.description: Amazon domain to use when building shop URLs from `handles`.
marketplaceDomain.title: Marketplace domain

maxItemsPerList.description: Maximum number of product items to extract per Idea List.
maxItemsPerList.title: Max items per Idea List

maxLists.description: Maximum number of Idea Lists to process per shop.
maxLists.title: Max Idea Lists per shop

maxVideos.description: Maximum number of creator videos to extract per shop (tabs=all or videos).
maxVideos.title: Max videos per shop

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy configuration. Defaults to the free AUTO (datacenter) group.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

shopUrls.description: Full creator storefront URLs, e.g. `https://www.amazon.com/shop/gearvlogz`. Use this for non-default marketplaces or when you already have the exact URL.
shopUrls.title: Shop URLs

tabs.description: Which tab(s) of the storefront to extract.
tabs.title: Content to scrape

useResidentialProxy.description: By default the actor uses the free AUTO (datacenter) proxy group with a homepage-priming retry, escalating to residential only after repeated blocks. Enable this to always use residential proxy from the start (higher reliability, uses paid proxy credit).
useResidentialProxy.title: Force residential proxy

title: Amazon Creator Shop Scraper Input
